messages:
anna: Quick thread to lock down the EU cutover safety knobs. Need clear canary stages, tenant opt-outs, KMS blackout check, and an ordered fallback (quant -> geo). Short please.

mike: Proposed stages? small -> med -> large? numbers?

anna: 4 stages: 2% -> 8% -> 25% -> 50%. 15m watch for first two, 30m for last two.

devon: Fallback order agreed: 1) model:vX-quant (same region), 2) route to nearest non-EU region, 3) manual hold. Automation should prefer downgrade before geo-failover.

lena: Flag spec: name `cutover.eu.model.vX.enabled`, owner=infra(lena), ttl=8h, tenant_exceptions list supported. Will PR YAML.

ops: We'll provide tenant_exempt list. Note: enterprise contracts require opt-out by default, confirm list before deploy. KMS rotation windows must not overlap.

qa: Semantic gate: quick 50-prompt run at 8% (fast pass) and full 200-prompt check at 25%. Hallucination threshold 2%, emb-sim delta threshold 0.03. Fail -> rollback.

mike: Telemetry snapshot on fail: capture traces, logits, prefix cache metrics, and example prompts. Store under restricted bucket.

devon: Pseudocode: if gate_fail -> disable flag -> enable model:vX-quant -> notify #incidents -> post snapshot. If capacity OOMs -> immediate downgrade; geo-route only if latency > 3x SLO.

anna: Runbook summary: preflight (confirm KMS + tenant list), stage deploys, automated gates at 8% and 25%, rollback policy, post-mortem freeze 48h if rollback. Owners: lena (flag), devon (fallback), qa (semantic), anna (product).

lena: I'll open PR today, include runbook checklist and tenant_exceptions field.

anna: Cool. Meeting 30m before window to confirm KMS. End of thread.
